name: Predictive Input Buffer
description: Buffers early jump inputs for a configurable number of physics ticks.

enabled.name: Enable Input Buffer
enabled.description: Queue jump press/release events while playing a level.

buffer-ticks.name: Buffer Window
buffer-ticks.description: Number of physics ticks to hold an input before applying it (2–16).

toggle-key.name: Toggle Buffer
toggle-key.description: Toggle the input buffer during gameplay.
